latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of feishu-openclaw-paper-manager.

- Enables ingestion of academic papers from Feishu messages (PDFs and source links).
- Saves assets or index docs to a cloud-docs paper folder, with normalized metadata in a Feishu multi-dimensional table.
- Implements deduplication based on DOI, arXiv/OpenReview ID, title, or URL fingerprint.
- Auto-generates summary sentences and layered, reusable tags (topic, method, task, domain, stage).
- Includes an evolving tag taxonomy that iterates every 50 new papers, with backfill and change logging.
- Defines clear workflow boundaries between the Feishu bot (ingestion, user interaction) and OpenClaw (parsing, enrichment, classification, storage).
